latest_release.name: v0.77.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Feature/log id expose by @xgreenx in https://github.com/FuelLabs/fuels-rs/pull/1699
* Make `IsUserAccountVariables` cloneable by @ironcev in https://github.com/FuelLabs/fuels-rs/pull/1705
* chore: bump MSRV to 1.93 by @xgreenx in https://github.com/FuelLabs/fuels-rs/pull/1706
* chore(deps): Bump `fuel-vm` to 0.66.2 and  `fuel-core` to 0.48.0 by @ironcev in https://github.com/FuelLabs/fuels-rs/pull/1707
* Add multi-URL client connect method. by @its-saeed in https://github.com/FuelLabs/fuels-rs/pull/1702
* chore(version): bump to v0.77.0 by @ironcev in https://github.com/FuelLabs/fuels-rs/pull/1710

## New Contributors
* @its-saeed made their first contribution in https://github.com/FuelLabs/fuels-rs/pull/1702

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FuelLabs/fuels-rs/compare/v0.76.0...v0.77.0
